help.text:
EthioBio AI Assistant — Help

Commands:
/start — Show menu
/help — This message
/ask <question> — Ask a biology question
/quiz [grade] [topic] — Generate a quiz
/grade <7-12> — Set your default grade
/language <en|am|both> — Set language
/socratic — Toggle Socratic tutoring mode
/hint — Get the next hint level (1-3) in Socratic mode
/cancel — Cancel current operation

Or just type any biology question to get started!

tutor.grade_prompt: Grade {grade} selected. Send me your biology question. I'll help you understand it!
tutor.no_question: No active question. Ask a question first with /ask or select Tutor from the menu.
tutor.socratic_on:
Socratic Mode is now ON.

In Socratic mode, I'll guide you through questions rather than giving direct answers — helping you discover the answer yourself!
tutor.socratic_off:
Socratic Mode is now OFF.

I'll give you direct answers with explanations.
tutor.hint_revealed: The answer has already been revealed! Ask a new question to continue.
tutor.hint_exhausted: You've used all hint levels. Tap 'Reveal Answer' to see the full explanation.
tutor.hint_usage: 📊 You used {count} hint(s) before revealing the answer.
tutor.misconception: 💡 I noticed a misunderstanding — gently corrected above.

• Who needs attention today?
• Why is a student struggling?
